classification.difficultyReason: Same task type as the anchor (equal-SD curves, shifted means), but the student must place two means on a numeric axis and draw identical shapes at the right positions.

content.prompt:
The masses of apples from two orchards are normally distributed. Orchard A has mean $150$ g and standard deviation $10$ g, and Orchard B has mean $180$ g and standard deviation $10$ g.
Draw both normal curves on the same axes, marking the means.

answer.short: Sample sketch: two identical bell-shaped curves, one centred at $150$ and the other at $180$.
answer.worked: The standard deviations are equal, so both curves have the same width and height. Draw one symmetric curve centred at $150$ and a second identical curve centred at $180$, shifted to the right.
